svg.title: Music replacement: silence before the new stream
svg.desc: BGMPlayer owns one stream. With a track change pending, each active fade callback moves the old stream toward zero volume. When its volume reaches zero, the player pauses and closes the old stream, then opens and starts the new stream at zero. Later callbacks move the new stream toward the target volume. Callbacks run every 200 milliseconds while a fade is active. The diagram shows order, not total duration, and the streams never overlap.
svg.text: BGMPlayer owns one stream. Read from top to bottom.
Track change pending: fade the old stream
1. Pause and close the old stream.
2. Open and start the new stream at zero.
Fade the new stream toward the selected volume
Active fade: 200 ms callbacks. Spacing is not duration.
